verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם מְֽסַפְּרִ֥ים כְּבֽוֹד־ אֵ֑ל וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דָ֗יו מַגִּ֥יד הָרָקִֽיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ haš·šā·ma·yim mə·sap·pə·rîm kə·ḇō·wḏ- ’êl ū·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏāw mag·gîḏ hā·rā·qî·a‘
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David The heavens declare the glory of God the skies proclaim the work of His hands

verses.original: י֣וֹם לְ֭יוֹם יַבִּ֣יעַֽ אֹ֑מֶר וְלַ֥יְלָה לְּ֝לַ֗יְלָה יְחַוֶּה־ דָּֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: yō·wm lə·yō·wm yab·bî·a‘ ’ō·mer wə·lay·lāh lə·lay·lāh yə·ḥaw·weh- dā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: Day after day they pour forth speech night after night they reveal knowledge

verses.original: אֵֽין־ אֹ֭מֶר וְאֵ֣ין דְּבָרִ֑ים בְּ֝לִ֗י נִשְׁמָ֥ע קוֹלָֽם׃
verses.literal: Without speech or language without a sound . . . to be heard

verses.original: בְּכָל־ הָאָ֨רֶץ׀ יָ֘צָ֤א קַוָּ֗ם וּבִקְצֵ֣ה תֵ֭בֵל מִלֵּיהֶ֑ם לַ֝שֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ שָֽׂם־ אֹ֥הֶל בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ yā·ṣā qaw·wām ū·ḇiq·ṣêh ṯê·ḇêl mil·lê·hem laš·še·meš śām- ’ō·hel bā·hem
verses.literal: their voice has gone out into all the earth their words to the ends of the world In the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun

verses.original: וְה֗וּא כְּ֭חָתָן יֹצֵ֣א מֵחֻפָּת֑וֹ יָשִׂ֥ישׂ כְּ֝גִבּ֗וֹר לָר֥וּץ אֹֽרַח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū kə·ḥā·ṯān yō·ṣê mê·ḥup·pā·ṯōw yā·śîś kə·ḡib·bō·wr lā·rūṣ ’ō·raḥ
verses.literal: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber like a champion rejoicing to run his course

verses.original: מִקְצֵ֤ה הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם׀ מֽוֹצָא֗וֹ וּתְקוּפָת֥וֹ עַל־ קְצוֹתָ֑ם וְאֵ֥ין נִ֝סְתָּ֗ר מֵֽחַמָּתוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: miq·ṣêh haš·šā·ma·yim mō·w·ṣā·’ōw ū·ṯə·qū·p̄ā·ṯōw ‘al- qə·ṣō·w·ṯām wə·’ên nis·tār mē·ḥam·må̄·ṯō
verses.literal: it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other nothing is deprived of its warmth

verses.original: תּ֘וֹרַ֤ת יְהוָ֣ה תְּ֭מִימָה מְשִׁ֣יבַת נָ֑פֶשׁ עֵד֥וּת יְהוָ֥ה נֶ֝אֱמָנָ֗ה מַחְכִּ֥ימַת פֶּֽתִי׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·raṯ Yah·weh tə·mî·māh mə·šî·ḇaṯ nā·p̄eš ‘ê·ḏūṯ Yah·weh ne·’ĕ·mā·nāh maḥ·kî·maṯ pe·ṯî
verses.literal: The Law of the LORD is perfect reviving the soul the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy making wise the simple

verses.original: פִּקּ֘וּדֵ֤י יְהוָ֣ה יְ֭שָׁרִים מְשַׂמְּחֵי־ לֵ֑ב מִצְוַ֥ת יְהוָ֥ה בָּ֝רָ֗ה מְאִירַ֥ת עֵינָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: piq·qū·ḏê Yah·weh yə·šā·rîm mə·śam·mə·ḥê- lêḇ miṣ·waṯ Yah·weh bā·rāh mə·’î·raṯ ‘ê·nā·yim
verses.literal: The precepts of the LORD are right bringing joy to the heart the commandments of the LORD are radiant giving light to the eyes

verses.original: יִרְאַ֤ת יְהוָ֨ה׀ טְהוֹרָה֮ עוֹמֶ֪דֶת לָ֫עַ֥ד מִֽשְׁפְּטֵי־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱמֶ֑ת צָֽדְק֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: yir·’aṯ Yah·weh ṭə·hō·w·rāh ‘ō·w·me·ḏeṯ lā·‘aḏ miš·pə·ṭê- Yah·weh ’ĕ·meṯ ṣā·ḏə·qū yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: The fear of the LORD is pure enduring forever . . . the judgments of the LORD are true being altogether righteous

verses.original: הַֽנֶּחֱמָדִ֗ים מִ֭זָּהָב וּמִפַּ֣ז רָ֑ב וּמְתוּקִ֥ים מִ֝דְּבַ֗שׁ וְנֹ֣פֶת צוּפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: han·ne·ḥĕ·mā·ḏîm miz·zā·hāḇ ū·mip·paz rāḇ ū·mə·ṯū·qîm mid·də·ḇaš wə·nō·p̄eṯ ṣū·p̄îm
verses.literal: They are more precious than gold than much pure gold they are sweeter than honey than honey from the comb

verses.original: גַּֽם־ עַ֭בְדְּךָ נִזְהָ֣ר בָּהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְרָ֗ם עֵ֣קֶב רָֽב׃
verses.literal: By them indeed Your servant is warned in keeping them is great reward
Who can discern his own errors Cleanse me from my hidden faults

verses.original: גַּ֤ם מִזֵּדִ֨ים׀ חֲשֹׂ֬ךְ עַבְדֶּ֗ךָ אַֽל־ יִמְשְׁלוּ־ בִ֣י אָ֣ז אֵיתָ֑ם וְ֝נִקֵּ֗יתִי מִפֶּ֥שַֽׁע רָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: gam miz·zê·ḏîm ḥă·śōḵ ‘aḇ·de·ḵā ’al- yim·šə·lū- ḇî ’āz ’ê·ṯām wə·niq·qê·ṯî mip·pe·ša‘ rāḇ
verses.literal: Keep Your servant also from willful sins may they not rule over me Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression

verses.original: יִֽהְי֥וּ לְרָצ֨וֹן׀ אִמְרֵי־ פִ֡י וְהֶגְי֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה צוּרִ֥י וְגֹאֲלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yih·yū lə·rā·ṣō·wn ’im·rê- p̄î wə·heḡ·yō·wn lib·bî lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā Yah·weh ṣū·rî wə·ḡō·’ă·lî
verses.literal: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight O LORD my Rock and my Redeemer
